newsitem.title: USA: ATC individual client growth slowed in Q3.
newsitem.headline: ATC individual client growth slowed in Q3.

text.p: ATC Communications Group Inc said revenue growth slowed in the third quarter as a result of lower than expected growth in individual client programs.

The company earlier reported fiscal third quarter revenues of about $24.5 million compared with $23.1 million a year earlier. Earnings per share fell by $0.03 to $0.02 per share in the 1997 third quarter.

ATC said it has since implemented an expense reduction program to match expenses with expected revenue levels and believes the negative client impact on revenues will not continue past the fourth quarter.

In addition to internal growth, ATC plans to continue a strategy of growth through acquisitions. The company said it is in discussions with several parties, although no agreements have been reached. It expects that any acquisition would fit the company's corporate and operating strategies.

ATC has entered into an alliance with Arthur Andersen to provide clients with comprehensive call center services. Arthur Andersen's consulting services should help identify appropriate technologies, improve call center operations and guide clients to higher market share, ATC said.

ATC also believes its shares are undervalued due to the recent decline in its share price. The board has authorized management to buy up to five million shares of common stock in the open market or privately-negotiated deals.
